sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A least-squares line for a data set is ŷ = 7x + 52, where x is measured in hour studieds and y in test points. Interpret the slope.
choices: Each additional hour studied is associated with an increase of about 7 test points.
Each additional hour studied causes an increase of exactly 7 test points.
Each additional test points is associated with 7 more hour studieds.
The predicted value is 7 test points when x is 0.

items.prompt: Towns with more fire engines report more fire damage. What conclusion is justified?
choices: Random assignment makes a causal conclusion reasonable, because the groups differ only by the treatment.
A strong correlation always establishes causation when the sample is large.
A third variable — warm weather — plausibly drives both, so correlation here is not evidence of causation.
Larger towns have both more engines and more fires, so the association reflects town size rather than a causal link.

items.prompt: A data set records 9, 20, 5, 12, 9. Give the mean and the median.
choices: mean 11, median 5
mean 9, median 11
mean 11, median 9
mean 11, median 11

items.prompt: A data set of five values between 10 and 30 has one additional reading of 180 appended. Which statement best describes the effect on the mean and the median?
choices: Both the mean and the median rise sharply.
The mean rises sharply while the median changes little, because the mean uses every value’s size.
The median rises sharply while the mean changes little.
Neither statistic changes, because one value cannot affect a summary.

items.prompt: A two-way table has row 1: 30 yes, 11 no; row 2: 18 yes, 23 no. Among row-1 respondents, what fraction answered yes?
A least-squares line for a data set is ŷ = 4x + 39, where x is measured in kilometre travelleds and y in litres of fuel. Interpret the slope.
choices: Each additional kilometre travelled causes an increase of exactly 4 litres of fuel.
The predicted value is 4 litres of fuel when x is 0.
Each additional litres of fuel is associated with 4 more kilometre travelleds.
Each additional kilometre travelled is associated with an increase of about 4 litres of fuel.

items.prompt: Ice cream sales and swimming-pool admissions are strongly positively correlated across a year. What conclusion is justified?
choices: A strong correlation always establishes causation when the sample is large.
Random assignment makes a causal conclusion reasonable, because the groups differ only by the treatment.
A third variable — warm weather — plausibly drives both, so correlation here is not evidence of causation.
Larger towns have both more engines and more fires, so the association reflects town size rather than a causal link.

items.prompt: A data set records 5, 30, 23, 26, 37, 22, 26. Give the mean and the median.
choices: mean 26, median 24.14
mean 24.14, median 24
mean 24, median 26
mean 24.14, median 26
